violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (Ice Machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Ice machine was turned off. Ice machine is not to be used until it has been clean and sanitized. Establishment is to send photo of cleaned and sanitized photo to RIDOH CFP before resuming use. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Prep unit 1 and 2 was observed held at 54 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Noodles, Tofu, sprouts, soup, duck, and eggs were voluntarily disposed of. Food items to be stored in working unit until repair is made. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
The hood system filters were observed with an excess of debris. Hood systems filters must be maintained clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The plumbing under the three bay sink was observed leaking when dishwasher was running. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Establishment is to fix leak under three bay sink New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025

The lighting in the walk in cooler is inadequate. Lighting in walk in cooler must be corrected so establishment is able to visually inspect items in walk in cooler. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025
